Biblical loci (Rev, Matt, Mark, Luke, John, Acts, Jas, Phil, 1 Thess) are merged into the Nestle 1904 entry; Old Testament loci (Zech, Ezek, Dan, Exod, Jer, Dan in Theodotion) into the Swete Septuagint entry. Josephus's four works are entered separately with their loci; the seated text is EA-CORPORA-01 (#1499), a record. Philo's works are given only as the abbreviations *Conf.* and *Her.*, left unexpanded. 'DJD' is given only as an abbreviation. The three blog posts (l.280) carry no author or site in the text; the archive's blog is presumably meant. The Haran Gawaita is named via #1758/#1735 with no edition. Not entered: Irenaeus (l.79, 'a reading of Irenaeus', no work), the Chaldaean Oracles (l.214, named only to exclude them), the Apostolic Fathers and the pseudepigrapha corpora used in the census (ll.340–342, no edition), the relief on the Arch of Titus (l.236, an object), Theodotion beyond the Swete entry, and the quote-check script (l.10, a repository file).
